shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null; cat package-lock.json 2>/dev/null | head -20; git log --oneline | head; node -v; npm -v

cat index.html; echo ---; ls -R src; echo ---; for f in src/*; do echo "== $f"; cat "$f"; done; echo ---; cat tsconfig.json vite.config.ts .gitignore; echo ---; ls __agent_eval__; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit >/dev/null && echo uikit-installed; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components | head -80; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep -E '"version"|"peerDependencies"' -A4

cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs | head -60; echo ---THEME; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/useTheme.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/ThemeContext.d.ts 2>/dev/null; echo ---TABS; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/tabs; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/tabs/TabList.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/tabs/Tab.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/tabs/TabProvider.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -80; echo ---LAYOUT; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/layout; echo ---ICONS; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons 2>/dev/null | head -3; echo ---SEG; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts | head -40

cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider.js; echo ---TYPES; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/tabs/types.d.ts; echo ---ICONS; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons | grep -iE '^(Moon|Sun|House|Person|Gear|Globe|CircleInfo)\.d' ; grep '"version"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/package.json; grep -c '' package-lock.json; grep -n '@gravity-ui/icons' package-lock.json | head -3; echo ---CARD; sed -n 1,40p node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Card/Card.d.ts

python3 - <<'EOF'
import re
p='src/pages/AboutPage.tsx'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("      <DefinitionList items={STACK} />\n","      <DefinitionList>\n        {STACK.map((item) => (\n          <DefinitionList.Item key={item.name} name={item.name}>\n            {item.content}\n          </DefinitionList.Item>\n        ))}\n      </DefinitionList>\n")
open(p,'w').write(s)
p='src/App.tsx'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("import { Button, Icon, Tab, TabList, Text, ThemeProvider } from '@gravity-ui/uikit';","import type { ReactNode } from 'react';\nimport { Button, Icon, Tab, TabList, Text, ThemeProvider } from '@gravity-ui/uikit';")
s=s.replace("let page: React.ReactNode;","let page: ReactNode;")
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
npm pkg set dependencies.@gravity-ui/icons="2.23.1" && npm install --offline --no-audit --no-fund 2>&1 | tail -3 && git status --short && echo ---TSC && npx tsc --noEmit && echo TSC_OK && echo ---TEST && npx vitest run 2>&1 | tail -15 && echo ---BUILD && npx vite build 2>&1 | tail -12

(which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome 2>/dev/null; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules/playwright* -d 2>/dev/null; echo "browser-check-done") ; (npx vite preview --port 4173 --strictPort >/tmp/preview.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 2; curl -s http://localhost:4173/ | head -5; curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' http://localhost:4173/; ls dist; grep -o 'g-root_theme_dark' dist/assets/*.css | head -1
node -e 'fetch("http://localhost:4173/").then(r=>r.text()).then(t=>{console.log(t.slice(0,400))}).catch(e=>console.error("ERR",e.message))'; pkill -f "vite preview" ; echo stopped; git status --short
cat src/App.tsx && echo --- && find src -type f | sort && git diff index.html .gitignore
